topic: Escola Preta de Arte abre inscrição com 8 formações gratuitas em artes cênicas Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: Escola Preta de Arte is offering 8 free courses focused on Afro-centered performing arts.
The courses are available until July 25, with limited spots.
The training sessions are in-person and last for 12 weeks.
Courses include Teatro Ancestral and Dramaturgia Preta Contemporânea, taught by recognized artists.
This initiative is part of a broader effort to promote Afrocentric methodologies in the arts.

quotes.text: Escola Preta de Arte, único ensino presencial de artes cênicas afro-referenciadas do Brasil, abre inscrição com 8 formações gratuitas.

summary: Escola Preta de Arte has opened registrations for eight free courses in Afro-centered performing arts, emphasizing the importance of Afrocentric methodologies. The courses are available until July 25 and are taught by acclaimed artists, aiming to enhance representation in the arts.
